audit.why: win[0..6] reads Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Master Yi, Skill, Master Yi and packet.levelChart is identical; the whys support each row (Fiora bullies 1-5, Highlander flips 6, first item even, his true-damage DPS wins late). Nothing to change.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built on Riposte timing without ever stating a cooldown, and Alpha Strike's cooldown is never given despite 'bait Alpha Strike' being the core instruction.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18 AND his basic attacks reduce it, so it is never a fixed clock; Meditate is a flat 10s; Highlander is a flat 85s and refunds his other cooldowns on a kill or assist; Fiora W is 24/22/20/18/16.
audit.corrected: late now carries the 20s Alpha Strike and its auto-refund; spikes[2].text carries the 10s Meditate.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED EFFECT: mid, late, spikes[3] and wants.you[2] all tell the player to 'kill him during the stun' after parrying. Riposte stuns ONLY if it blocked an immobilizing effect, and Master Yi's kit contains no immobilize at all — Alpha Strike is an untargetable dash, Meditate a self-channel, Wuju Style a passive, Highlander a self-buff. Against him Riposte can never stun.
audit.why: That mistake is decisive, not cosmetic: the page's entire win pattern is 'parry, then kill inside the stun'. A player following it commits into a Yi who is not locked down at all and dies with W on a 24s cooldown. Also missing: Alpha Strike makes him untargetable, so damage dumped into the dash is lost; Meditate heals and takes reduced damage, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades; Wuju Style is true damage, so armour is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: mid, late, spikes[3] and wants.you[2] rewritten to 'blank the commit and slow him', with the untargetable dash, the 10s Meditate heal and Wuju Style's true damage stated.

edits.before: Level 6 flips the aggression: Highlander lets him burst you inside any Riposte-down window, so W becomes your entire fight — hold it for his real commit, parry the moment he locks in, and kill him during the stun. At first item it's dead even and hinges completely on whether he dodges or eats the parry.
edits.after: Level 6 flips it: Highlander bursts you inside any Riposte-down window, so W is your whole fight — hold it for his real commit. Riposte will NOT stun him; nothing in his kit immobilizes, so you get the block and a slow, not a free kill. At first item it's even and hinges on whether he dodges or eats the parry.

edits.before: The rule never changes: his true-damage DPS wins any fight where Riposte is on cooldown, so never offer one. Bait Alpha Strike before committing, parry his engage, and run your vitals inside the stun — that's your only clean win pattern. If W is down, disengage immediately and reset the dance.
edits.after: The rule never changes: his true-damage DPS wins any fight where Riposte is on cooldown, so never offer one. Bait Alpha Strike (20s, and his autos refund it) — he is untargetable through the dash, so burst spent into it is lost. Parry the follow-up, run your vitals, and leave the moment W is down.

edits.after: His true DPS wins whenever Riposte is on cooldown — parry his commit to blank it and slow him, then disengage.

edits.after: Two-plus items are his — Wuju Style true damage beats armour once Riposte is down, so only fight with W up and blank his commit.
